# BarChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Bar chart that renders vertical bars with value labels above each bar. Now supports multiple series. Uses the ICanvas interface for rendering, making it backend-agnostic.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new BarChart()
new BarChart(ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`BarColor`](#barcolor): Color for the bars (backward compatibility).
- [`BarStyle`](#barstyle): Value-end rounding and optional opaque linear gradient.
- [`BarWidthRatio`](#barwidthratio): Width of bars as percentage of available space (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.6).
